title: Append behavior
requirements: 08.01. `append()` has the required signature and return type.
08.02. Omitted metadata results in an empty immutable mapping in the entry.
08.03. Omitted `createdAt` results in the current UTC time.
08.04. Explicit metadata is validated and normalized according to the `JournalEntry` requirements.
08.05. Explicit `createdAt` is validated according to the `JournalEntry` requirements.
08.07. Entry validation and normalization are not implemented as divergent competing rules in multiple places.
08.08. The allocated sequence equals the current next sequence.
08.09. The sequence counter advances only after entry construction succeeds.
08.10. Failed entry construction cannot consume a sequence number.
08.11. Successful appends produce monotonically increasing sequence numbers.
08.12. A sequence number is never reused.
08.13. The created entry is retained before `append()` returns.
08.14. `append()` returns the same entry that was retained.
